pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take: **Mustard Boy's strategy is lookin' as solid as a paper umbrella in a Texas thunderstorm.** I mean, Zach thought draftin' Saudi Arabia was like hittin' an ATM for goals — newsflash, partner, ain't gonna happen, even with their oil money. While Gunner's sittin' pretty at the top with France puttin' in work like a pit crew at NASCAR, Zach's Brazil ain't been pullin' their weight lately, and it's showin' with them measly 35 points. Meanwhile, Devin's Spain just put the smackdown on Portugal, so I'd back them to keep rollin' like a tumbleweed through the next match. Don't get too cozy, Gunner — Devin's climbin' faster than a cat up a tree. But at the end of the day, Mustard Boy's still out here runnin' like a broken lawnmower, and I'm callin' it now: Zach's team picks won't even sniff the semis — book it!
